summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. Changes in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, namespace as prefix argument); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref == a stored term URI (node-type-aware equality), inherited by _RDFNamespace; _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). NamespaceManager untouched, no imports added. Added tests in test/test_namespace.py (NamespacePrefixTest): Namespace prefix positive/self/proper-prefix/contains-not-prefix and SH; RDFS positive, undefined-term negative, plain-string and Literal negatives; RDF positive and _1 container negative. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. Nothing committed.
